Which valet does your car need?

  • It's cleaned regularly and just needs freshening up.Mini Valet
  • The seats or carpets are marked, the boot is grubby, or it's going back to the leasing company.Full Valet
  • It needs everything: leather seats, the roof lining, the arches.Platinum Valet

Still not sure? Send two or three photos of the seats, carpets and outside on WhatsApp. We'll tell you which valet it needs before you book. Send photos on WhatsApp

How a mobile valet works

  1. Get in touch Use the quote form, WhatsApp or call 07469 184950. Tell us the car, your postcode and the valet you want.
  2. Pick a time We work Monday to Saturday 8am to 6pm, and Sunday 8am to 1pm.
  3. We come to you We can bring our own water and power, so all we need is space to work around the car. You don't need to be home.
  4. Check it over If you're home, Connor walks round the car with you when it's finished. Pay by card, cash or bank transfer.

Where we can valet your car

On your drive, outside your house, or in your workplace car park. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: any limits, e.g. roadside parking, flats, underground car parks, needing the employer's permission]

Valeting questions

Do you need water or electricity from me?

No. We can bring our own water and power, so we don't need anything from you. All we need is space to work around the car.

What happens if it rains?

Light rain doesn't stop us working. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: what happens if the weather is too bad to work, e.g. how rebooking works.]

Do I need to be at home?

No. As long as we can get to the car, you don't need to be in. We'll arrange access and keys with you when you book. If you are at home, Connor will walk round the car with you when it's finished.

Do you clean child seats?

Yes, if you ask. Let us know when you book and we'll include them.

What's the difference between valeting and detailing?

A valet cleans the car, inside and out. Detailing goes further and works on the paint itself, using machine polishing to reduce swirls and light scratches and coatings to protect it. If the paint looks dull or marked once it's clean, detailing is the next step.
